why: the original bug: protect any marker-SHAPED span, forged or not
a store hiccup must NOT silently disable redaction
the OTHER direction: if we stop trusting our own markers, a later broad pattern corrupts the round-trip
note: EXPECTED MISS (defense in depth, verified 2026-07-31). Round 16 changed the email domain hint from the literal domain to an industry bucket, so no hint value can contain a tokenizable value any more: hints are now industry=business, len=NN, century=19, initials=AA. The `trusted` bookkeeping for freshly minted markers protected against a later broad pattern re-matching INSIDE a hint, which was only reachable while the hint carried a hostname. Keep the bookkeeping (a future hint key could reintroduce the shape) but it is no longer load-bearing. Not decay.
